It quantifies the agreement in differential expression status (upregulation, downregulation, or no change) of genes between two species.",

    "8,317 ortholog genes are remained for CAMO analysis in Case Study 1.",

    "MS has almost zero genome-wide and pathway-specific c-scores with all five human studies.",
    "MS shows d-scores = 0.2 to 0.4 for the three selected KEGG pathways when compared to HS and the four human validation studies.",
    "When HS is compared to the four human validation studies, the d-scores dropped to ~−0.3.",
